why_best: Anchoring abstract user flows inside a physical housing elevates digital features into a premium product experience that feels ready for consumer hands.
why_bad: Popping a raw 2D screen capture straight onto the canvas deprives the feature of tangible context and feels like an unpolished presentation slide.
trap: A flawed attempt will lock the dynamic element rigid after its entry, breaking the illusion of a weightless, tangible showcase.
